highlights.title: The Journey Starts
highlights.description: Come to Melbourne for high-level education, starting from Trinity Collecge, as a turning point of my life.

highlights.title: University of Melbourne
highlights.description: Completed the course works at Trinity Collecge, and enough age, too. If I've been born few months earlier, probably I can get into Uni one sem earlier?

highlights.title: Gained Views from a Rhythm Game Fanmade
highlights.description: Designed a April-Fools day like fanmade Arcaea chart and brought fun to over 52k people (quite a lot for such a niche topic hahaha). Wanna have a look? Search BV1YQ4y1h7KK on Bilibili~

highlights.title: Graduation Ceremony
highlights.description: Completed my study at the University of Melbourne, as a Student from Computing & Software Systems.

highlights.title: Started my first career
highlights.description: Stared my role as a Software Engineer in DO group, can't wait to turn thoughts to reality with skills I've got and will gain!

highlights.title: Barista
highlights.description: I love coffee for milk flavoring, so I get my barista licence on that day. Now I'm a barista for myself XD.

highlights.title: Baptism
highlights.description: Baptism in to Christ as a Seventh-Day Adventist at Gateway City Church. Praise the Lord for His grace and help across my spiritual journey. This day, becomes my spiritual birthday!

highlights.title: Completion of this Site
highlights.description: Accomplishment of my personal website, including a snack map into a closed beta readiness.

highlights.title: My RAG App is Live
highlights.description: Forked and deployed my RAG app for improved solution for the company's Chatbot program. It bootsted the respond speed by 141% while saves token, worked way better than I thought! (No pic since it's company's secret~)

highlights.title: Worked out full-auto deployment
highlights.description: How amazing is automation! No manual anymore, free from on-calls~ I configured all the main projects with a automated workflow with GitHub Actions.

highlights.title: Got Admission into MSAI at NTU
highlights.description: Successfully admission into NTU's MSc of Artificial Intelligence programme (fully DIY~), a brand new change to learn things deeper and possibly contribute some novel ideas to the industry!

highlights.title: Arriving NTU, Singapore
highlights.description: Finalement I'm here at the iconic building at NTU! What I have to say... Singapore is sooooooo hot!

highlights.title: TechFest 2026 Hackathon
highlights.description: Taking part in the hackathon - TechFest 2026. Our team built the platform trailify.fit within 24h. Although we didn't being chosen to be finalist, take-aways are still a lot and the experience is fresh and enjoyable!
